nodes.label: ComLinked Software Requirements Specification
nodes.rationale: Master copy (v0.2 draft, 2026-11-10) that gives a team enough detail to estimate, build and test the MVP; three parts: Real MVP, Phase 2, Mockup. Word copy is generated from it.

nodes.label: One Job: First Lead Within 24 Hours
nodes.rationale: The free MVP has one job: a first real lead within 24 hours, then a reason to return daily. Every feature must help companies sign up, get leads, return daily, talk to other companies or share wins; anything else waits.

nodes.label: Daily Lead Loop
nodes.rationale: Every MVP feature supports one step: Morning Digest, act on Leads, talk and close in ComMail, share the win, rank rises and brings more views into the next digest.

nodes.label: ECCP Pilot (European Chamber of Commerce of the Philippines)
nodes.rationale: Decided 2026-11-10, replacing PCCI-Quezon City which the plan named first. Soft launch covers 30 to 50 companies and opens to all members after two weeks of fixes.

nodes.label: AI Lead Agent Task Document and Process Specification
CON-01 No Payments, Paywall or Premium Tiers
Service Seam (CON-08)
nodes.rationale: Screens and Server Actions access data only through src/services/*; each service begins as a mock and becomes real by changing that service only (ADR 0003).

nodes.label: CON-09 RSC Reads, zod-validated Server Action Writes
CON-10 No Custom Admin Console
nodes.rationale: Staff use the database dashboard in the MVP, which is why the Team Dashboard is deferred to Phase 2.

nodes.label: CON-11 Person Approves Every Outgoing Message
nodes.rationale: AI drafts and a person decides: the AI Assistant never sends on its own.

nodes.label: ASM-05 owner and admin Treated as Authorized Representatives
A2 Claim Your Profile
nodes.rationale: The '3 companies are already a match' claim message only shows when at least 3 Matches exist (Adoption 8), keeping A2 consistent with L1.

nodes.label: L2 ComDash Interest Signals
nodes.rationale: Every Interest Signal shows the company name free of charge; no name is blurred for any Company (Plan 1).

nodes.label: D1 Morning Digest
nodes.rationale: Sent by web push and email at 8:00 a.m. local; email fallback covers iPhone users without the installed web app (Adoption 9).

nodes.label: D3 Activity Score and Search Rank
D5 Monthly Top Companies
nodes.rationale: Recognition only: no prizes, badges or tiers in the MVP.

nodes.label: C1 Company Connections
nodes.rationale: Connections belong to the Company and remain when a representative leaves.

nodes.label: C3 AI Assistant Switch
nodes.rationale: One per-Company On/Off switch; drafts only from the two Companies' profiles and thread; every screen works with the switch off.

nodes.label: C4 Outcome Buttons (We met / We did business)
Activity Score Point Rules (BR-01 to BR-09)
Search Rank Formula (BR-11)
nodes.rationale: Rank = relevance x (1 + activity boost up to 30%). Relevance always comes first, and Connection Degree never affects order, so two viewers see the same results.

nodes.label: Configuration Settings (CFG-01 to CFG-12)
nodes.rationale: Every Proposed number that affects product behavior is a configuration setting, so it can be tuned without a code change.

nodes.label: CI Quality Gates and Coverage Floors (NFR-MNT)
Logical Data Model
nodes.rationale: Directory data is shared across a Chamber Network; private data is protected per Organization (ADR 0009).

nodes.label: UC-03 Message with an AI Draft
UC-04 Confirm a Deal and Share It
UC-06 Post and Answer an Ask
Pilot Success Measures
nodes.rationale: The pilot succeeds if Companies get a Lead on day one and keep returning on their own within 90 days; targets are starting points reset after the first month.

nodes.label: AI Lead Agent
nodes.rationale: Phase 2: acts for one Company under a written Mandate, qualifies matches and books a virtual meeting at a match score of 75 or more; people make every commitment.

nodes.label: Match Score (7 categories, out of 100)
nodes.rationale: Called a match score, not a probability, until 200 meetings are completed (AG-11).

nodes.label: Match Score Bands: Book, Nurture, Drop
Agent Rate Limits and Outbound Pause
LLM Judgment, Deterministic Enforcement (AG-32)
nodes.rationale: The language model handles conversation and judgment; deterministic services enforce scoring, disclosure, approvals and rate limits, so the model cannot decide on its own to share or book.

nodes.label: ComLinked Team Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Phase 2 because the MVP keeps the database dashboard; Community Managers stay responsible for their Chamber and staff act only as back-up.

nodes.label: Clickable Mockup
nodes.rationale: One HTML file with no server, ignored by git; its code is throwaway but its flows and layouts are the reference for Part 1.

nodes.label: Mockup Simulated vs Real Behaviors
nodes.rationale: Fit Score, rank, Activity Score and limits carry over as real logic; acceptance thresholds and the overnight attention formula do not.

nodes.label: OD-04 Uncapped Invite Points
nodes.rationale: BR-09 has no limit, so throwaway companies could earn unlimited points.

nodes.label: OD-06 Agent Autonomy vs 'AI Drafts, a Person Decides'
Out of Scope for the MVP
